# Scripts reject unsupported forms even inside exception handlers.
# Parameterized types follow the BigQuery data types reference.

BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'BEGIN SELECT 1; END'; EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

BEGIN EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'BEGIN TRANSACTION'; EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN SELECT 1; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

CALL d.p(); SELECT 1
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

BEGIN TRANSACTION; CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f(x INT64) AS (x); ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

BEGIN BEGIN TRANSACTION; SELECT 1 / 0; EXCEPTION WHEN ERROR THEN COMMIT TRANSACTION; END
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

SET @@time_zone = 'Asia/Tokyo'; SELECT CURRENT_DATE()
=> error contains: The emulator does not support

SELECT 1;
SELECT 1/0;
=> error contains: division by zero

DECLARE x STRING(3) DEFAULT 'abcd'; SELECT x
=> error:

# Answers collected from BigQuery with bqanswers: definitions cannot refer to system variables.
# BigQuery appends the location of the defining statement, which the emulator does not report.
SET @@dataset_id = 'before';
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION current_dataset() AS (@@dataset_id);
SET @@dataset_id = 'after';
SELECT current_dataset()
=> error contains: Invalid reference to system variable @@dataset_id; in function current_dataset

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_dataset_system_variables;
SET @@dataset_id = 'errors_dataset_system_variables';
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW errors_dataset_system_variables.v AS SELECT @@dataset_id AS dataset_id;
SET @@dataset_id = 'after';
SELECT dataset_id FROM errors_dataset_system_variables.v
=> error contains: Invalid reference to system variable @@dataset_id

SET @@dataset_id = 'before';
CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (@@dataset_id);
SELECT 1
=> error contains: Invalid reference to system variable @@dataset_id; in function f

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (@@dataset_id);
SELECT f()
=> error contains: Invalid reference to system variable @@dataset_id; in function f

CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS errors_dataset_system_variables;
SET @@dataset_id = 'errors_dataset_system_variables';
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION errors_dataset_system_variables.f() AS (@@dataset_id);
SELECT errors_dataset_system_variables.f()
=> error contains: Invalid reference to system variable @@dataset_id

CREATE TEMP FUNCTION f() AS (@@project_id);
SELECT f() IS NOT NULL
=> error contains: Invalid reference to system variable @@project_id; in function f
